in_marathi.name: AishwaryaRajesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Grace, Wealth, and Rule
in_marathi.long_meaning: AishwaryaRajesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aishwarya means 'God's Grace, Divine Grace, Goddess Lakshmi, Wealth, Fortune, and Prosperity'. Rajesh means 'Ruler, King, or Rule'. The name AishwaryaRajesh signifies the grace of God, wealth, and the one who rules.
